shared_elements: horizontal band/register divider running across the surface
repeated figures of the same kind arranged in a row
stacked registers of imagery on a vertical face
band of small repeated ornamental units (chevron/zigzag row in A, rosette row in B)
justification: Both surfaces divide a vertical face into stacked registers separated by a horizontal band of small repeated ornamental units, with a row of same-kind figures in profile above, which is a generic compositional convention rather than a specific shared motif. The depicted subjects are entirely different: A shows schematic, disproportionate animals (birds, quadrupeds, a long-necked creature) with no attributes, while B shows naturalistically proportioned standing human figures in profile with tall headdresses, robes, bows, quivers and spears.
